DEFINING MOMENTS

TOP 5 CAREER MILESTONES

  1. 1

    2016 Spanish Grand Prix (Youngest Winner in History)

    Promoted to Red Bull Racing mid-season at age 18y 228d. Held off Kimi Räikkönen for 32 laps to claim maiden victory.

    MAY 15, 2016
  2. 2

    2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix (First World Championship)

    Final-lap overtake into Turn 5 on fresh soft tires to seal his historic maiden Formula One title against Lewis Hamilton.

    DEC 12, 2021
  3. 3

    2022 Belgian Grand Prix (P14-to-P1 Spa Masterclass)

    Started 14th after engine penalties, took the race lead in just 12 laps, and won by over 17.8 seconds in the Ardennes forest.

    CIRCUIT DE SPA-FRANCORCHAMPS
    AUG 28, 2022
  4. 4

    2023 Italian GP Monza (Record 10 Consecutive F1 Wins)

    Smashed Sebastian Vettel's all-time record by securing 10 Grand Prix victories in a row during a dominant 19-win season.

    SEP 03, 2023
  5. 5

    2024 São Paulo Grand Prix (P17-to-P1 Rain Phenomenon)

    In torrential Interlagos weather, sliced past 16 cars and clocked 17 fastest laps to lock down the 4th consecutive World Title.

    NOV 03, 2024
